title: PrimaLuce shared archive recipe fails with the configured macOS libtool
summary: The recipe hard-codes ar-style rcs after $(AR), but macOS config sets AR=/usr/bin/libtool and ARFLAGS=-static -o. A clean archive build fails with libtool usage and exit 2, preventing a clean focuser_primaluce build. Reproduced with BUILD_LIB redirected to a new /tmp directory. Next: coordinator assigns a portable archive-recipe repair using configured ARFLAGS, with clean macOS and GNU-ar verification; preserve atomic publication.

title: PrimaLuce reply lookup accepts shorter keys as the requested field
summary: primalucelib_find_token compares only the received key length with strncmp. ABS_POS therefore satisfies a request for ABS_POS_STEP; the reproducer reports present=1 and returns 123 for an absent field. Units/position-field selection can be wrong despite successful missing-field guards. Next: coordinator assigns exact-length key matching with serial/HTTP parsed-reply regression cases, existing library/driver suites and affected version bookkeeping.

title: Travis commands reference missing test and Windows solution paths
summary: CI invokes indigo_test/test_suite.sh, which is absent, and changes into indigo_windows before invoking a solution that now lives at the repository root. Those commands fail even when compilation otherwise succeeds. Next: coordinator assigns CI command repair to current portable test and solution entry points; validate path resolution without installing dependencies or probing hosted CI.

title: Driver editor omits the supported polaralign device class
summary: DEVICES excludes polaralign although the generator and two checked-in definitions support it. Both polaralign definitions fail preview with no supported device. The fresh unchanged generator directly regenerates both successfully. Next: coordinator assigns editor class/catalog integration and corpus regression coverage; no generator change is needed.

title: Editor attribute catalog omits the generator-supported device id
summary: The template-derived device catalog does not offer id, accepted by parse_device_block and needed for named logical devices. Source-to-catalog contract test fails without any generator binary dependency. Next: coordinator assigns a template/editor catalog correction and reruns the existing attribute contract test; preserve existing DSL input.

title: Editor source mapping loses CCD properties on explicitly identified logical devices
summary: Mapping uses device kind for generated-function prefixes and misses explicit logical-device identifiers used by the generated CCD simulator. Corpus test finds an empty generated range for inherited CCD_EXPOSURE. Next: coordinator assigns device-identity-aware mapping and tests that select all CCD logical devices; do not alter generator output merely for highlighting.

title: Driver development guides link a removed scoped instruction filename
summary: Five developer-facing relative links still name indigo_drivers/AGENTS.override.md, which does not exist after consolidation to AGENTS.md. Readers cannot reach the instructions the guides designate as authoritative. Next: coordinator assigns a scoped link/label update and verifies all affected local destinations.

title: Checked-in client examples do not compile against current public headers
summary: The mount example, included by the examples all target, calls indigo_connect_server with four arguments although the header requires five. The older client.c also lacks standard-name declarations and passes integer descriptors to an adapter requiring indigo_uni_handle pointers. Exact compiler diagnostics are retained; this is distinct from FND-000010 unbounded connection handling. Next: coordinator assigns example API migration and isolated compile checks; preserve separate runtime-failure findings.

title: HTTP BLOB gzip uses an input-sized buffer and can serve an incomplete gzip stream
summary: The HTTP caller allocates only the uncompressed byte count for gzip output. The compressor accepts a non-final deflate result and reports partial output. For bytes 0..31 in a 32-byte buffer it returns 32 bytes; a zlib decoder returns -5 rather than Z_STREAM_END and recovers only 15/32 bytes. The HTTP caller would label and send the partial stream with 200 OK. Next: coordinator assigns bounded gzip-capacity/error-contract repair and HTTP incompressible-payload regression coverage; audit did not perform a network download.
